derived: each INFOMAR inshore survey grid (heights above LAT), pixels deeper than 45 m below LAT dropped and the grid cut to the rest and to the Ireland box (11.0-5.3 W, 51.2-55.6 N, as a UTM 29N rectangle); grids in UTM 28N / 30N / lon-lat warped to UTM 29N (bilinear, own resolution). Values unchanged otherwise.
